- [ ] `feat` — new behavior

- [ ] `refactor` — no intended behavior change

## Test plan

- [ ] `flutter analyze` prints **No issues found!**

- [ ] Drift codegen run and generated files committed (if schema/migrations changed)
- [ ] `flutter gen-l10n` run (if `lib/l10n/app_en.arb` changed)
- [ ] Matching `docs/` (and `docs/user-guides/` for UX) updated when behavior changed
